settings.text: Barsana Magic reflects the story of tradition, devotion, and health. We are deeply dedicated to creating a strong connection between nature, farmers, and you. Partnering with farmers across the sacred land of Braj Bhumi and beyond, we cultivate sustainable organic farmland, ensuring the well-being of the ecosystem and the communities we work with. Our roots are embedded in Sanjeevani Organics, where we specialize in producing premium organic dairy and gourmet products with a commitment to purity and sustainability for the environment. This partnership allows us to bring you natural, ethically produced food that upholds the highest quality standards. Quality is our utmost concern and for the same every batch goes to stringent lab tests, so we can assure you the certified Organic Food basket to your kitchen. Our farmers are producers and religiously dedicated individuals working as a team for healthy living and a better planet. We support them with the knowledge and resources to practice organic and sustainable farming and domestication of Indian breed cows known for A2 quality milk, and they grow crops under National Organic Program (NOP) and National Programme for Organic Production (NPOP) standards with the help of trained food experts and doctors. By choosing Barsana Magic, you help the next generations by protecting the environment, supporting farmers, and bringing a touch of Magic of health & wellness into your home with pure, certified organic and natural dairy products.

Our Milestone

2008

The Beginning of Sanjeevani Organics Sanjeevani Organics was founded with a mission to revolutionize agriculture through organic farming practices. The company began with a strong focus on sustainability and empowering local farmers to adopt eco-friendly methods of cultivation.

2012

Entering the Retail Sector
After four years of establishing its presence in organic farming, Sanjeevani Organics entered the retail market. This was a major step towards bringing high-quality organic products directly to consumers, broadening its market reach.

2013

Expansion into the U.S. Market
Sanjeevani Organics crossed borders and entered the U.S. market in 2013. This international expansion was a significant achievement, positioning the company as a trusted global supplier of organic products.

2017

Partnering with Aditya Birla Retail Limited
In a strategic partnership, Sanjeevani Organics became a key supplier of organic products to Aditya Birla Retail Limited. This collaboration enhanced the company's presence in the Indian market through the supply of organic products under the Aditya Birla brand.

2018

Facility Expansion in Bhagwanpur, Roorkee
To meet rising demand and ensure better processing capabilities, Sanjeevani Organics expanded its infrastructure with a newly built processing unit in Bhagwanpur, Roorkee, Uttarakhand. This facility marked a new chapter of growth and innovation for the company.

2021

Further Expansion in Dehradun,Uttarakhand Continuing its growth trajectory, Sanjeevani Organics set up another state-of-the-art processing unit in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. This expansion boosted production capacity, enabling the company to serve larger markets both domestically and internationally.

2023

Recognition from the Uttarakhand Government
In recognition of its efforts in strengthening the organic farming sector, Sanjeevani Organics received a prestigious Certificate of Appreciation from the Uttarakhand Government. This accolade highlighted the company’s contributions to sustainable agriculture in the region.

2023

Partnership with Amul (Banas Dairy)
Another significant milestone was achieved when Sanjeevani Organics partnered with Amul (Banas Dairy) to supply organic products for the "Amul Organic" brand. This collaboration marked an important association with one of India's largest and most respected dairy brands.

2024

Launch of Organic Dairy Products under "Barsana Magic"
Sanjeevani Organics made a bold move into the organic dairy market with the launch of cow milk in Tetra Pak packaging under the brand name "Barsana Magic." This new venture showcased the company’s commitment to diversifying its product range and delivering high-quality organic dairy options to consumers.

settings.text: Ethics play a crucial role in shaping the values and practices of companies involved in producing organic food. These ethics  at Barsana Magic  are based on the principles of sustainability, environmental responsibility, and social justice. Companies practicing organic agriculture must adhere to strict guidelines and regulations set by various organizations and controlling bodies  to ensure that their products are truly organic. This includes using only natural fertilizers and pesticides, promoting biodiversity, and treating their workers fairly. Additionally, these companies often prioritize local and small-scale production, minimizing their carbon footprint and supporting local economies. Their ethical practices also extend to transparency and honesty in labeling and marketing their products. By upholding these principles, organic agriculture companies not only provide consumers with healthier and more sustainable food options but also contribute to the overall improvement of our environment and society.
